hook_text: A wedding ring, a drill bit and a light switch: what do they have in common?
clip_script: Bloemfontein, show-and-tell. A gold wedding ring: gold never rusts, and it carries electricity, so it's in your cellphone too. Most of our gold comes from the Witwatersrand. A diamond-tipped drill bit: diamonds are the hardest natural substance, so most are used for cutting and drilling. First found near Hopetown, then Kimberley. And a light switch: most of our electricity comes from coal, mined in Mpumalanga. South Africa: rich in minerals.
visual_style: Whiteboard ring, drill bit and light bulb, each linked by a line to a mine on a map of South Africa.
mood: Lively and surprising, like a show-and-tell.
pacing: Three quick reveals, one mineral each.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make a list of minerals in your kitchen.
